notificationMacCompatibility.en: macOS uses a legacy compatibility API; display is unverified. Notification permissions and Focus settings have not been checked.
notificationMacCompatibility.zh-CN: macOS 通过旧版兼容接口尝试通知，显示未验证；通知权限和专注模式尚未检查。

commandDebug.en: Open manual notification, sound and status checks
commandDebug.zh-CN: 打开通知、声音与状态的手动排查

commandUsage.en: /cue — settings; /cue debug — manual checks. Opening either does not send a test notification or play a sound.
commandUsage.zh-CN: /cue 打开设置；/cue debug 打开手动排查。仅打开不会发送测试通知或播放声音。

configEnvelope.en: Expected schemaVersion 1 and a settings object; file protected
configEnvelope.zh-CN: 需要 schemaVersion 1 和 settings 对象；原文件受到保护

configJson.zh-CN: JSON 格式损坏；原文件受到保护

configFile.en: Configuration must be a regular file at most 256 KiB
configFile.zh-CN: 配置必须是最大 256 KiB 的普通文件

configBusy.en: Configuration busy; reload and retry. A stale lock requires manual review.
configBusy.zh-CN: 配置正被占用；重新加载后重试。遗留锁需要人工检查。

configConflict.en: Configuration changed in another process; reload before retrying
configConflict.zh-CN: 配置已被其他进程修改；请先重新加载再重试

askReuse.en: Ask skipped: reused toolCallId or tracking capacity reached
askReuse.zh-CN: 跳过 Ask：toolCallId 重复或跟踪容量已满

askUnowned.en: Ask skipped: no matching current-session native tool execution
askUnowned.zh-CN: 跳过 Ask：未找到当前会话对应的原生工具执行

subagentStartUnowned.zh-CN: 跳过子任务启动：协议、会话或所有者未经验证

subagentCapacity.en: Subagent tracking capacity reached; new runs are skipped until restart
subagentCapacity.zh-CN: 子任务跟踪容量已满；重启前跳过新任务

subagentCompletionUnowned.zh-CN: 跳过子任务完成：会话、所有者或 runId 未经验证

subagentGap.en: Subagent completion skipped: duplicate, unobserved start or reload/session observation gap
subagentGap.zh-CN: 跳过子任务完成：重复、未观察启动或重载/会话切换存在观测空窗

subagentResult.en: Subagent completion skipped: unknown final result
subagentResult.zh-CN: 跳过子任务完成：最终结果未知

integrationMalformed.zh-CN: 忽略集成事件：数据格式错误

focusObserver.en: Focus: passive host-report observer; unknown follows the configured policy
focusObserver.zh-CN: 焦点：被动观察宿主报告；未知时按配置策略处理

notificationSsh.en: Notification skipped: SSH has no local desktop ownership
notificationSsh.zh-CN: 跳过通知：SSH 无法确认本机桌面归属

notificationPlatform.en: Notification skipped: selected backend does not match this platform
notificationPlatform.zh-CN: 跳过通知：所选后端与当前平台不匹配

notificationDesktop.en: Notification skipped: no desktop D-Bus session
notificationDesktop.zh-CN: 跳过通知：没有桌面 D-Bus 会话

notificationSilence.en: Notification skipped: server has not advertised mandatory suppress-sound support
notificationSilence.zh-CN: 跳过通知：服务未声明必须支持静音的 sound 能力

notificationResult.en: Notification {backend}: {result}; submitted does not mean displayed
notificationResult.zh-CN: 通知后端 {backend}：{result}；已提交不代表实际显示

soundFallback.en: Custom WAV unavailable; trying the default preset once
soundFallback.zh-CN: 自定义 WAV 不可用；尝试默认预设一次

wavContainer.en: Expected an uncompressed RIFF WAV file
wavContainer.zh-CN: 需要非压缩 RIFF WAV 文件

wavPcm.en: Only integer PCM WAV is supported

wavFormat.en: PCM WAV requires mono/stereo, 8/16 bit, 8–96 kHz
wavFormat.zh-CN: PCM WAV 需要单/双声道、8/16 位、8–96 kHz

wavMissing.en: WAV format or audio data is missing
wavMissing.zh-CN: 缺少 WAV 格式或音频数据

wavFile.en: WAV must be a regular file at most 20 MiB
wavFile.zh-CN: WAV 必须是最大 20 MiB 的普通文件
